direvos: dezir + vos — I shall tell you (infinitive dezir + enclitic vos + auxiliary, split future: direvos for dezir vos he; Direvos de los cavalleros 'I shall tell you of the knights'; = os diré)
levaron: levar — they carried, took (preterite 3rd pl., -aron written -aron/-ar-on; levaron el menssaje 'who bore the message'; = llevaron)
menssaje: menssaje — message, the news or word sent (noun, ss = s; = mensaje)
plógol: plazer + le — it pleased him (strong preterite plogo 3rd sg., impersonal, + enclitic le, e dropped; plógol de coraçon 'it pleased him from the heart'; = le plugo, modern le plació)
coraçon: coraçón — heart (final -n form; de coraçon 'heartily, sincerely'; = corazón)
deve: dever — he ought, must (present 3rd sg.; tal deve sperar 'such he must expect'; = debe)
sperar: esperar — to expect, await (infinitive, with e- lost; tal deve sperar 'he must expect the like'; = esperar)
cavalguedes: cavalgar — ride (present subjunctive 2nd pl. in -edes, a polite command; cavalguedes con çiento 'ride with a hundred'; = cabalgad, cabalguéis)
vayades: ir — (that) you go (present subjunctive 2nd pl. in -ades, used as a command; vayades a Molina 'go to Molina'; = vayáis)
iaze: yazer — lies, is situated (present 3rd sg.; Molina, que iaze más adelant 'Molina, which lies farther on'; = yace)
tiénela: tener + la — holds it (present 3rd sg. tiene + enclitic la, accent shifted; tiénela Avengalvón 'Avengalvón holds it'; = la tiene)
avengalvón: Avengalvón — Abengalbón, the Moorish lord of Molina, a friend and ally of the Cid (proper name, from Arabic ibn Ghalbūn; the epic's spelling Avengalvón; = Abengalbón)
conssigrá: conseguir — he will accompany, escort (future 3rd sg., ss = s, e of the stem syncopated; bien vos conssigrá 'he will escort you well'; the sense 'accompany' is Pidal's reading and not quite certain; = os acompañará, modern conseguir means 'to obtain')
pudiéredes: poder — (as soon as) you may be able (future subjunctive 2nd pl.; quanto lo pudiéredes far 'as fast as you can do it'; = pudiereis)
dixieron: dezir — they said (strong preterite 3rd pl., x = sh-sound; así commo a mí dixieron 'as they told me'; = dijeron)
podredes: poder — you will be able (future 2nd pl., syncopated for poderedes; hi los podredes fallar 'you will be able to find them there'; = podréis)
aduzídmelas: aduzir — bring (them) to me (imperative 2nd pl. aduzid + enclitic me + las; aduzídmelas delant 'bring them before me'; = traédmelas)
costadom: costar + me — has cost me (past participle costado + enclitic me, m before the next word; mucho costadom ha 'it has cost me dear'; with ha as perfect auxiliary; = me ha costado)
locura: locura — madness, folly (noun; grand locura seríe 'it would be great folly'; = locura)
seríe: ser — would be (conditional 3rd sg. in -íe; = sería)
desenparás: desenparar — you abandon (future 2nd sg. after si, 'if you abandon it', generic 'one'; si la desenparás 'if one were to give it up'; = desamparar, closest abandonar)
ffincaré: fincar — I shall remain (future 1st sg., ff = f; yo ffincaré en Valençia 'I shall stay in Valencia'; = quedaré, modern hincar means 'to drive in')
fincan: fincar — they stop, cease (present 3rd pl.; non fincan de andar 'they do not stop riding'; = quedan, closest cesan)
troçieron: trocir — they passed, crossed (preterite 3rd pl.; troçieron Santa María 'they went past Santa María'; the verb is rare and the reading 'pass' is Pidal's; no modern form)
fronchales: Fronchales — a place on the Cid's men's road before Molina, taken to be Fronchales in the Sierra de Albarracín (Teruel); the identification is the usual one but not certain (proper name; = Fronchales)
viniéron: venir — they came (preterite 3rd pl.; viniéron a Molina posar 'they came to lodge at Molina'; = vinieron)
moro: moro — Moor, Muslim (noun; el moro Avengalvón 'the Moor Avengalvón'; = moro)
speró: esperar — he waited for (preterite 3rd sg., e- lost; non speró a nadi 'he waited for nobody'; = esperó)
saludava: saludar — was greeting, sends greetings (imperfect 3rd sg.; mio Çid vos saludava 'the Cid sends you his greetings', the imperfect of a message; = saludaba)
recabdar: recabdar — to carry out, see to (infinitive; mandólo recabdar 'he ordered it carried out'; = recaudar, here closest cumplir)
privádol: privado + le — quickly, at once, for him (adverb privado + enclitic le, e dropped; que privádol acorrades 'that you help him promptly'; = pronto le)
adugades: aduzir — (that) you bring (present subjunctive 2nd pl.; adugades gelas acá 'bring them here to him', gelas = le + las; = traigáis, closest llevéis)
ffata: fata — until, as far as (preposition, ff = f; ffata en Valençia 'as far as Valencia'; = hasta)
partades: partir — (that) you part, separate (present subjunctive 2nd pl., prohibition with non, reflexive vos; non vos partades 'do not leave them'; = os apartéis, closest os separéis)
çientol: çiento + le — a hundred (of them) to him (çiento + enclitic le, e dropped; çientol pidieron 'they asked him for a hundred'; = cien)
montañas: montaña — mountains, wooded highlands (pl.; Passan las montañas 'they cross the mountains'; = montañas)
mata: mata — thicket, scrub; here the first word of the place name Mata de Taranz, taken to be the brush-land near Taranz (Guadalajara) on the way to Medinaceli; the placing is the usual one (noun; = mata)
arbuxuelo: Arbuxuelo — the valley of the Arbujuelo, a stream running down toward Medinaceli (river/valley name, restored by Pidal; = Arbujuelo)
deprunar: deprunar — to go down, descend steeply (infinitive; pienssan a deprunar 'they set about going down'; etymology doubtful; no modern form)
armados: armar — armed (past participle masc. pl.; vídolos venir armados 'he saw them come armed'; = armados)
temiós: temer + se — he took alarm, was afraid (preterite 3rd sg. temió + reflexive -s(e)); temiós Minaya 'Minaya took alarm'; = se temió)
coranado: coronar — crowned, tonsured (past participle masc. sg. with a for o; obispo coranado 'tonsured bishop, i.e. in orders'; = coronado)
alcáyaz: alcáyaz — alcaide, governor, commander (Arabic al-qāʾid, a variant of alcaide; alcáyaz Avengalvón 'the governor Avengalvón'; = alcaide)
trahe: traer — brings (present 3rd sg., h marking the old hiatus; fuerças que trahe 'the forces he brings'; = trae)
óndral: ondra + le — honour to him (noun ondra + enclitic le, e dropped; óndral dar 'to give him honour'; = honrarle, honra)
llegarán: llegar — they will arrive (future 3rd pl.; agora llegarán 'now they will arrive'; = llegarán)
ffo: ser — was (preterite 3rd sg. fo + restored letter, ff = f; Esso fo apriessa fecho 'that was quickly done'; = fue)
pareçen: pareçer — they look, appear (present 3rd pl.; non pareçen mal 'they look splendid'; = parecen)
cuberturas: cubertura — horse-covering, caparison (pl.; cuberturas de çendales 'caparisons of silk'; = cobertura, closest gualdrapa)
çendales: çendal — sendal, fine thin silk (pl.; = cendales)
peytrales: peytral — horse's breast-strap, breast-piece (pl.; peytrales a cascaviellos 'breast-straps hung with bells'; = petral)
cuellos: cuello — neck (pl.; escudos a los cuellos 'shields hung at the neck'; = cuellos)
seso: seso — mind, wits, judgment, character (de qué seso era 'what kind of mind he had'; = seso, now 'brain')
saliera: salir — he had gone out, set out (pluperfect indicative 3rd sg. in -ra, from the Latin pluperfect; qu[o]mo saliera de Castiella 'how he had left Castile'; = había salido)
mesurando: mesurar — keeping measure, going at a restrained pace (gerund; ivan mesurando 'they were going along in good order'; the exact sense is uncertain; = mesurar)
llegando: llegar — arriving, drawing near (gerund; llegando delant 'coming up ahead'; = llegando)
toman: tomar — they take (present 3rd pl.; toman armas 'they take up arms'; = toman)
tómanse: tomar + se — they set about (present 3rd pl. toman + reflexive se, accent shifted; tómanse a deportar 'they set to sporting'; = se ponen a)
deportar: deportar — to sport, amuse oneself (infinitive; tómanse a deportar 'they set to play'; = deportarse, closest divertirse)
homillar: omillar — to bow, pay homage (infinitive, with unetymological h-; se van homillar 'they go to pay their respects'; = humillarse)
sonrrisándose: sonrisar + se — smiling (gerund + enclitic se, rr = r; = sonriéndose)
hivalo: ir + lo — he went to (embrace) him (imperfect 3rd sg. iva spelt hiva + enclitic lo; hivalo abraçar 'he went to embrace him'; = lo iba a (abrazar))
ombro: ombro — shoulder (noun; en el ombro lo saluda 'he greets him on the shoulder', a salutation by touch; = hombro)
husaje: usaje — custom, habit (noun, h- spelling; tal es so husaje 'such is his custom'; no common modern form, closest uso)
traedes: traer — you (pl.) bring (present 2nd pl. in -edes; Traedes estas dueñas 'you bring these ladies'; = traéis)
valdremos: valer — we shall be worth, shall gain in worth (future 1st pl.; por o valdremos más 'through whom we shall be worth more'; = valdremos)
ondrar: ondrar — to honour (infinitive; ondrar vos hemos 'we shall honour you', infinitive + vos + auxiliary, split future; = honrar)
abrá: aver — he will have (future 3rd sg., b for v; de lo nuestro abrá 'he will have of ours'; = habrá)
muchol: mucho + le — very much, to him (mucho + enclitic le, e dropped; muchol tengo por torpe 'I hold him a great fool'; = mucho le)
conosçe: conoscer — knows, recognizes (present 3rd sg.; qui non conosçe la verdad 'who does not know the truth'; = conoce)

__broaden__.natural: natural — natural, rightful, by birth (adjective; señor natural 'a rightful lord, one owed allegiance by birth'; = natural) · also natural — native of a place, true (el Burgalés natural 'the native of Burgos'; amigo natural 'a friend by nature, true-born friend')
__broaden__.recabdo: recabdo — care, precaution, strict order (= recaudo) · also recabdo — business secured, a sure outcome (con todo buen recabdo 'with everything well in hand') · recabdo — account, reckoning (oro e plata que non saben recabdo 'gold and silver past all reckoning') · also con recabdo — within bounds, under control (non es con recabdo el dolor de Valençia 'the grief of Valencia is past all bounds') · also todo el recabdo 'all in order, all well provided' (en Medina todo el recabdo está 'at Medina everything is in good order')
__broaden__.tornó: tornar — he turned (preterite 3rd sg.) · also tornar — he went back, returned (el otro tornó a Albar Fáñez 'the other went back to Minaya')
__broaden__.sabor: sabor — pleasure, wish; a so sabor 'at his (their) pleasure' · also por sabor de 'out of a wish to please, for the sake of' (por sabor de mio Çid 'to please the Cid')
